item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-05
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects, with notable updates in `scienceverse/metacheck`, `giladfeldman/docpluck`, `Davidvandijcke/coarse`, `JamieCummins/regcheck`, and `giladfeldman/escicheck`. The `scienceverse/metacheck` project now features a more streamlined import and export process, while `giladfeldman/docpluck` has updated documentation to reflect recent run outcomes and implemented fixes to normalize code. Meanwhile, `Davidvandijcke/coarse` has added funding links and a support button, and `JamieCummins/regcheck` has addressed bugs and improved its demo page. Additionally, `giladfeldman/escicheck` has been synced with the escicheckapp repository to ensure consistency across versions. These updates demonstrate the connections and collaborations within our community, and we celebrate the hard work and dedication of our contributors. As our projects continue to evolve, we look forward to seeing the impact of these changes and the new developments on the horizon.

item.title: docpluck: 38 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

Work was done on the `main` branch. The documentation was updated to record the outcomes of run-8, including that B6 was decided as NO-GO, and two run-7 remedies were corrected, as stated in the commit message "docs(todo): record run-8 outcomes — B6 decided NO-GO, two run-7 remedies corrected". The `docs(evidence)` section was also updated to include the complete 8-canary B6 result and the measurement of a W0o implementation blocker, as noted in the commit "docs(evidence): complete 8-canary B6 result + W0o implementation blocker measured". A fix was applied to normalize the code, specifically to strip BIDI FORMAT marks in S6, as described in the commit "fix(normalize): strip BIDI FORMAT marks in S6 (v2.4.125)". Additionally, the documentation was updated to reflect the results of various audits and handoffs, including the re-audit of docpluck's own won't-fix rulings and the adjudication of DP-3, as mentioned in commits such as "docs(audit): re-audit docpluck's OWN won't-fix rulings + heading-tier measurement" and "docs(audit): DP-3 cross-project adjudication — verdict upheld, MECHANISM REFUTED".
